items.headline: Man Utd beat Leeds 5-4 on penalties in pre-season friendly at Croke Park
items.summary: United drew 1-1 with Leeds in Dublin friendly, winning 5-4 on penalties. Match featured pitch invaders attempting selfies at the end.

items.headline: Radek Vitek completes move from Man Utd to Middlesbrough for £7m
items.summary: Goalkeeper Radek Vitek has joined Middlesbrough from Manchester United. Deal worth initial £7m, rising to £14m with performance clauses.

items.headline: Carrick says trio will be available for Milan clash
items.summary: Michael Carrick hopes three players will be available for upcoming match against AC Milan. Team news ahead of next fixture.

items.headline: Martinez returns from summer break to rejoin squad
items.summary: Lisandro Martinez has returned from summer break and rejoined Manchester United's squad for pre-season preparations.
